method: For every direct call to a proven WGSERVER import thunk, inspect a bounded post-call instruction window after optional immediate ADD ESP cleanup and classify the first observed EAX read or overwrite.
interpretation_limits: EAX consumption proves the caller uses a machine-word return value or returned pointer-like value; it does not recover the exact C return type.
No local EAX consumption does not prove void because use may occur beyond the bounded window or through flags/other conventions.
Floating-point, EDX:EAX, hidden structure returns, indirect calls, and host-internal behavior remain outside scope.
